quarterly_data.signal: CEO Bill Brown and CFO Anurag Maheshwari: Q3 adjusted organic growth 3.3%, adjusted operating margin 26.2% (up 110 basis points), adjusted EPS $2.50 (up 12%), GAAP EPS $2.63 (up 70%), free cash flow $1.2 billion; gross margin up 230 basis points; Safety and Industrial organic growth 7% (electrical markets double digits), Transportation and Electronics 0.5% (consumer electronics down mid-teens, about 5% growth outside it), Consumer flat; U.S. and Canada grew about 7%, China down high single digits.

CFO Anurag Maheshwari, guidance: 2026 adjusted EPS raised to $9.10-$9.15 (from $8.95-$9.10 on the new basis that excludes acquisition amortization), growth of 11% to 12%; organic growth of just over 4% in Q4 and more than 3.5% for the year; operating margin about 24.6% on the new basis; free cash flow about $4.8 billion; tax rate about 20%; oil inflation now $185 million (from $150 million-$175 million), fully offset by price. For 2027 (formal guidance in January): margin above the Investor Day target of 25.4% on the new basis, incrementals closer to 40%, incremental stranded costs of $50 million.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 adjusted EPS $9.10-$9.15; free cash flow about $4.8 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Orders and backlog (CEO Bill Brown, CFO Anurag Maheshwari): orders grew high single digits in Q3 (about 7%), backlog entering Q4 is up about 18% year-over-year with about 25% of the quarter's revenue in backlog; Safety and Industrial and Transportation and Electronics orders and backlog are up double digits; cross-selling wins total $140 million to date with $120 million more in the pipeline.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog up about 18%; about 25% of Q4 revenue in backlog

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Bill Brown: data center revenue will be about $700 million this year versus around $550 million last year, mostly outside the data center (electrical connections such as medium-voltage connectors, growing double digits), with optical, copper and other parts inside; Nextel ceramic fiber capacity is being expanded for behind-the-meter demand; 87 new products launched in Q3 (up 24%), over 350 this year; 16 manufacturing sites and distribution centers closed year to date with 10 more over the next 12 months; the Madison Fire & Rescue JV is EPS neutral with about $200 million of incremental revenue next year (CFO); in space materials 3M launched a lightweight reflective film for a commercial constellation in Q3 and plans a solar-panel moisture barrier in Q4; 3M is working with a court-appointed mediator in the AFFF personal injury MDL.
quarterly_data.figure: data center revenue about $700 million this year vs about $550 million last year

players.product: Expanded Beam Optical (EBO) fiber optic connectivity for data centers (EBO ferrules, co-packaged optics solutions)

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Bill Brown on Expanded Beam Optical (EBO): revenue is about $40 million this year and likely to double next year (roughly $80 million to $100 million); internal manufacturing capacity has doubled to more than 10 million ferrules a year, and contract manufacturer GSEO could potentially make multiples of that per month as it scales from Q4 into early next year; the addressable market is about $2 billion around 2028; the EBO Multi-Source Agreement grew from 17 to 63 members, another hyperscaler demonstrated EBO running live traffic at the Open Compute summit, and proof-of-concept work continues with other hyperscalers.
quarterly_data.figure: EBO revenue about $40 million in 2026; capacity more than 10 million ferrules a year

connects_to.relationship: EBO optical connectivity and other data-center products for Amazon data centers

contracts.signal: CEO Bill Brown on the Amazon agreement and warrant: the commercial relationship covers optical connectivity, EBO and other data-center products; there are no volume commitments ('we got to earn a right to that'); the $6 billion of cumulative sales over seven years is the target at which the warrant fully vests, in increments, and sales should start to ramp toward the back end of next year and become more meaningful in 2028.
contracts.value: no volume commitments; $6 billion of cumulative sales over seven years is the warrant's full-vesting target

players.product: high-precision optical components for optical interconnects and CPO (high-precision prisms, micro lens arrays, metalens, V-grooves, MT ferrules)

contracts.signal: CEO Bill Brown: 3M signed a contract manufacturing agreement with Genius Electronic Optical (GSEO) and took a 4.7% stake; GSEO will help scale EBO manufacturing on top of 3M's internal capacity, could potentially produce multiples of 3M's more than 10 million ferrules a year per month, and with GSEO the combined footprint should be sufficient if the hyperscalers in proof of concept convert.
